// shape: the go/parser front end admits Go struct grammar the hand
// parser rejected by name: a field name list and a comment between
// the fields, next to a tagged field with omitempty defeated.
type Size struct {
	// W and H share one spelling, as in Go.
	W, H int64
	Area int64 `json:"area,omitempty"`
}
s := Size{W: 3, H: 4, Area: 12};
assert.Equal(tb, 3, s.W);
assert.Equal(tb, 4, s.H);

var u Size;
u.W = 7;
assert.Equal(tb, 7, u.W);

buf := bytes.NewBufferString("");
json.NewEncoder(buf).Encode(s);
assert.Equal(tb, "{\"W\":3,\"H\":4,\"area\":12}\n", buf.String());
